التهاب حاد في جدار المرارة ينتج غالبًا ع: Acute inflammation of the gallbladder wall, usually caused by a gallstone blocking its duct. It causes constant pain in the upper right abdomen lasting more than a few hours, with fever and tenderness when pressed.
يحتاج إلى تقييم في المستشفى خلال ساعات:: Needs hospital assessment within hours: temporary fasting, intravenous fluids, painkillers and antibiotics if needed, usually followed by keyhole gallbladder removal within days. Go to the emergency department immediately if yellowing, severe shivering or general deterioration develops.
انتقال حصوة من المرارة إلى القناة الصفرا: A stone passes from the gallbladder into the common bile duct and blocks the flow of bile, causing upper abdominal pain with yellowing, dark urine and pale stools.
يحتاج إلى تقييم عاجل بتحاليل وظائف الكبد: Needs urgent assessment with liver function tests and imaging. The stone is usually removed endoscopically (ERCP), followed by gallbladder removal. Go to the emergency department immediately if you develop fever and shivering or severe pain spreading to the back.
عدوى بكتيرية في القنوات الصفراوية المسدو: A bacterial infection of bile ducts that are blocked, usually by a stone or tumour. It causes fever, shivering, yellowing and pain in the upper right abdomen, and can quickly progress to sepsis.
حالة طارئة: مضادات حيوية وريدية وسوائل ف: An emergency: intravenous antibiotics and fluids in hospital, then unblocking the duct endoscopically (ERCP) or by drainage through the skin within hours to a day depending on severity. Go to the emergency department immediately.
نتوءات صغيرة في جدار المرارة تُكتشف غالب: Small growths in the gallbladder wall, usually found by chance on ultrasound. Most are harmless (cholesterol deposits), but the risk is higher if they are larger than 1 cm or growing.
متابعة بالأشعة الصوتية حسب الحجم وعوامل: Ultrasound follow-up depending on size and risk factors, with gallbladder removal if the polyp is 1 cm or larger, grows quickly or causes gallbladder pain. See a doctor to agree a follow-up plan and do not ignore it.
انسداد ميكانيكي في الأمعاء الدقيقة بسبب: A mechanical blockage of the small bowel caused by a large gallstone that has passed into the bowel through a fistula between the gallbladder and the bowel. It mainly affects older people.
حالة طارئة تحتاج إلى أشعة مقطعية وجراحة: An emergency that needs a CT scan and surgery to remove the stone from the bowel, along with fluid correction. Go to the emergency department immediately.
استمرار ألم يشبه ألم المرارة أو عسر هضم: Ongoing gallbladder-like pain, indigestion or diarrhoea after gallbladder removal. It may be due to a stone left in the bile duct, sphincter of Oddi dysfunction or another cause not related to the gallbladder.
تحاليل وظائف الكبد وأشعة للبحث عن حصوة م: Liver function tests and imaging to look for a retained stone or narrowing, and treatment of the cause. See a doctor if the pain keeps coming back, and go to the emergency department if yellowing develops with fever.
التهاب مستمر يؤدي إلى تليّف البنكرياس وف: Ongoing inflammation that leads to scarring of the pancreas and gradual loss of its function. It is often linked to alcohol, smoking or repeated attacks, and causes recurrent upper abdominal pain, poor fat digestion and sometimes diabetes.
الامتناع التام عن الكحول والتدخين، وتسكي: Stop alcohol and smoking completely, pain relief, pancreatic enzymes with meals if digestion is poor, and monitoring of blood sugar and vitamins. See a doctor regularly, and go to the emergency department if you have a severe attack of pain with vomiting.
تجمّع سوائل محاط بجدار ليفي يتكوّن بعد ا: A collection of fluid surrounded by a fibrous wall that forms weeks after acute or chronic pancreatitis. It may cause fullness and upper abdominal pain or press on the stomach.
كثير منها يختفي تلقائيًا ويُتابع بالأشعة: Many go away on their own and are monitored with scans. They are drained endoscopically if large, if symptoms persist or if infected. Go to the emergency department if you have sudden severe pain, fever or vomit blood.
نقص إنزيمات البنكرياس اللازمة لهضم الدهو: A lack of the pancreatic enzymes needed to digest fat and protein, causing greasy, foul-smelling stools, bloating and weight loss. It occurs after chronic pancreatitis or pancreatic surgery, or with cystic fibrosis.
إنزيمات البنكرياس مع كل وجبة، وتعويض الف: Pancreatic enzymes with every meal, replacement of fat-soluble vitamins, and a balanced diet without severe fat restriction. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis with a stool test and find the cause.
أعراض تستدعي استبعاد سرطان البنكرياس: Symptoms that need pancreatic cancer to be ruled out
علامات قد تدل على ورم في البنكرياس، أبرز: Signs that may point to a tumour in the pancreas, most notably painless yellowing, unexplained weight loss, upper abdominal pain spreading to the back, and new diabetes after 50.
يحتاج إلى أشعة مقطعية عاجلة على البنكريا: Needs an urgent CT scan of the pancreas and blood tests, then referral to a specialist cancer team if a tumour is confirmed. See a doctor within a few days and do not delay, as early diagnosis changes treatment options.
طيف من إصابات الكبد الناتجة عن شرب الكحو: A range of liver damage caused by long-term alcohol drinking. It starts with fatty liver and can progress to inflammation and then cirrhosis.
الامتناع التام عن الكحول هو أساس العلاج: Stopping alcohol completely is the basis of treatment, with psychological and medical support to quit, good nutrition, and assessment of liver scarring with blood tests and scans. See a doctor regularly, and go to the emergency department if you develop yellowing, vomit blood or become confused.
التهاب حاد شديد في الكبد يصيب من يشرب ال: Severe acute inflammation of the liver in people who drink heavily. It causes rapid yellowing, mild fever, and a painful, enlarged liver, and can be life-threatening.
يحتاج إلى تقييم عاجل في المستشفى لتحديد: Needs urgent hospital assessment to determine severity, stopping alcohol completely, and nutritional support. Medicines may be needed in severe cases. Go to the emergency department if confusion, bleeding or reduced urine develops.
تجمّع سوائل في تجويف البطن، وأشيع أسبابه: A build-up of fluid in the abdominal cavity, most commonly caused by cirrhosis. It shows as an increase in waist size and weight and swelling of the legs.
تقييم عاجل وبزل عيّنة من السائل لتحليلها: Urgent assessment and a sample of fluid drawn off for testing, less salt, diuretics under medical supervision, and drainage of large amounts. Go to the emergency department if fever, abdominal pain, confusion or reduced urine develops.
عدوى بكتيرية في سائل الاستسقاء لدى مرضى: A bacterial infection of ascites fluid in people with cirrhosis without an obvious surgical cause. It may cause fever and abdominal pain, or only general deterioration and confusion.
حالة طارئة: بزل السائل للتأكيد ومضادات ح: An emergency: a fluid sample to confirm it and intravenous antibiotics in hospital with kidney support, followed by long-term preventive medicine after recovery. Go to the emergency department immediately.
اضطراب في وظائف الدماغ لدى مرضى الكبد ال: A disturbance of brain function in people with advanced liver disease caused by a build-up of toxins such as ammonia. It ranges from sleep problems and forgetfulness to confusion and coma.
تقييم عاجل للبحث عن المحفّز (عدوى أو نزي: Urgent assessment to find and treat the trigger (infection, bleeding, constipation, dehydration or sedative medicines), with laxatives that reduce ammonia absorption and a gut antibiotic for prevention. Go to the emergency department immediately if a person with liver disease becomes confused.
نزيف من أوردة متوسعة في المريء أو المعدة: Bleeding from enlarged veins in the oesophagus or stomach caused by high pressure in the portal vein in people with cirrhosis. It shows as vomiting blood or black stools and can be heavy and life-threatening.
حالة طارئة: نقل إلى المستشفى فورًا لتعوي: An emergency: go to hospital immediately for blood and fluid replacement, medicines that lower portal vein pressure and preventive antibiotics, followed by endoscopic banding of the varices within hours. People with known varices should keep to preventive medicines or regular banding.
عدوى فيروسية حادة في الكبد تنتقل عبر الط: An acute viral infection of the liver spread through contaminated food or water or close contact. It causes fever and nausea followed by yellowing, and usually clears completely without becoming chronic.
علاج داعم بالراحة والسوائل وتغذية خفيفة: Supportive care with rest, fluids and light meals, avoiding alcohol and medicines that strain the liver, handwashing to prevent spread, and vaccination of contacts as recommended. See a doctor to confirm with a blood test, and go to the emergency department if confusion, persistent vomiting or bleeding develops.
عدوى مستمرة لأكثر من ستة أشهر بفيروس الت: Infection with hepatitis B virus lasting more than six months, spread through blood, sex or from mother to baby. It often causes no symptoms but can lead to cirrhosis or liver cancer.
تقييم لدى طبيب الكبد بتحاليل الحمل الفير: Assessment by a liver specialist with viral load, liver enzyme and liver scarring tests, antiviral treatment when needed, lifelong regular follow-up, and vaccination of contacts. See a doctor and do not stop treatment on your own.
عدوى مزمنة بفيروس التهاب الكبد C تنتقل ب: A chronic infection with hepatitis C virus, usually spread through blood. It can stay silent for many years while causing cirrhosis.
تُعالج اليوم بمضادات فيروسية فموية لبضعة: It is now treated with oral antiviral tablets for a few weeks, with very high cure rates, after assessing the degree of liver scarring. See a doctor to complete tests and start treatment, and avoid alcohol.
عدوى فيروسية حادة في الكبد تنتقل غالبًا: An acute viral infection of the liver, usually spread through contaminated water in areas with poor sanitation. It usually clears on its own but can be severe in pregnant women and people with liver disease.
علاج داعم بالراحة والسوائل وتجنّب الكحول: Supportive care with rest and fluids, avoiding alcohol, and drinking safe water. See a doctor to confirm it. A pregnant woman with jaundice should go to the emergency department without delay, as should anyone who becomes confused or has bleeding.
التهاب مزمن في الكبد يهاجم فيه الجهاز ال: Chronic liver inflammation in which the immune system attacks liver cells. It is more common in women, is linked to other autoimmune conditions, and may cause tiredness, yellowing or only raised liver enzymes.
تأكيد التشخيص بالأجسام المضادة وخزعة الك: The diagnosis is confirmed with antibody tests and a liver biopsy, followed by long-term immune-suppressing treatment, which usually works well. See a liver specialist regularly and do not stop treatment suddenly.
مرض مناعي مزمن يدمّر القنوات الصفراوية ا: A chronic autoimmune disease that slowly destroys the small bile ducts inside the liver. It mainly affects middle-aged women, and symptoms include tiredness, itching and raised alkaline phosphatase.
دواء يحسّن تدفق العصارة الصفراوية يُؤخذ: A lifelong medicine that improves bile flow and slows the disease, along with treatment for itching and prevention of osteoporosis. See a liver specialist to confirm with antibody tests and for regular follow-up.
التهاب وتليّف مزمن في القنوات الصفراوية: Chronic inflammation and scarring of the bile ducts inside and outside the liver, causing them to narrow. It is strongly linked to ulcerative colitis.
متابعة لدى طبيب الكبد بتصوير القنوات بال: Follow-up with a liver specialist using MRI scans of the bile ducts, endoscopic widening of significant narrowings, and regular colonoscopy because of the higher risk of cancer. Go to the emergency department if you have fever with shivering and yellowing.
مرض وراثي يزيد فيه امتصاص الحديد فيتراكم: An inherited condition in which too much iron is absorbed and builds up in the liver, pancreas, heart and joints. If untreated, it can cause tiredness, joint pain, diabetes and cirrhosis.
سحب الدم الدوري (الفصد) لخفض مخزون الحدي: Regular removal of blood (venesection) to lower iron stores, avoiding iron supplements, vitamin C supplements and alcohol, and testing first-degree relatives. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis with a genetic test.
مرض وراثي نادر يتراكم فيه النحاس في الكب: A rare inherited condition in which copper builds up in the liver and brain. It usually appears between childhood and age 40 as liver disease or movement and psychiatric problems.
أدوية تطرد النحاس أو تمنع امتصاصه مدى ال: Lifelong medicines that remove copper or block its absorption, eating fewer copper-rich foods, and testing siblings. See a liver specialist or neurologist for diagnosis, and go to the emergency department if rapid yellowing or confusion develops.
تجمّع صديدي في الكبد سببه بكتيريا تصل عب: A collection of pus in the liver caused by bacteria reaching it through the bile ducts or blood, or by amoebae after a bowel infection. It causes high fever and pain in the upper right abdomen.
يحتاج إلى تقييم عاجل بالأشعة وتحاليل الد: Needs urgent assessment with scans and blood tests, and antibiotics or anti-amoebic medicines for several weeks. The abscess may need draining with a needle guided by imaging. Go to the emergency department if you feel dizzy, have low blood pressure or sudden severe pain.
عدوى طفيلية بيرقة الدودة الشريطية للكلاب: A parasitic infection with the larva of the dog tapeworm that forms a slow-growing cyst, usually in the liver or lung. It is common in livestock-farming areas.
تقييم بالأشعة لتحديد مرحلة الكيس، ثم علا: Imaging to assess the stage of the cyst, followed by antiparasitic treatment with drainage through the skin, surgery or monitoring depending on the case. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you have sudden severe pain, or a rash, swelling and shortness of breath (possible cyst rupture).
أكثر أورام الكبد الحميدة شيوعًا، وهو تجم: The most common benign liver tumour. It is a cluster of blood vessels, usually found by chance on a scan, and does not turn into cancer.
تأكيد التشخيص بأشعة مناسبة (رنين أو مقطع: The diagnosis is confirmed with a suitable scan (MRI or contrast CT). It usually needs no treatment or long-term follow-up, and surgery is considered only for large tumours that cause symptoms. See a doctor to confirm the nature of the spot.
أعراض تستدعي استبعاد سرطان الكبد: Symptoms that need liver cancer to be ruled out
علامات قد تدل على سرطان الخلايا الكبدية،: Signs that may point to hepatocellular carcinoma, which mostly affects people with cirrhosis or chronic hepatitis B or C. It may show as a new lump on a scan, a sudden worsening of liver function or weight loss.
يحتاج إلى أشعة مقطعية أو رنين بالصبغة وت: Needs a contrast CT or MRI scan, an alpha-fetoprotein blood test and referral to a liver cancer team within days. People with cirrhosis are advised to have an ultrasound scan every six months for early detection.
التهاب أو ركود صفراوي في الكبد ناتج عن د: Liver inflammation or blocked bile flow caused by a medicine, herbal remedy or dietary supplement. It shows as raised liver enzymes, yellowing or itching days to weeks after starting the substance.
إيقاف المادة المشتبه بها بعد استشارة الط: Stop the suspected substance straight away after speaking to a doctor, have liver function and clotting tests within a day or two, and follow up until results return to normal. Go to the emergency department if confusion, bleeding or marked yellowing develops, or after a paracetamol overdose.
حالة وراثية شائعة غير ضارة يقل فيها تكسي: A common, harmless inherited condition in which bilirubin is broken down more slowly, causing brief mild yellowing with fasting, illness or stress, while liver function is normal.
لا تحتاج إلى علاج، ويكفي تأكيدها بتحليل: No treatment is needed. It is confirmed by an indirect bilirubin test with otherwise normal results. Avoid long fasting and dehydration. See a doctor if the yellowing comes with dark urine, pale stools or abdominal pain.
ارتفاع في إنزيمات الكبد يُكتشف في تحليل: Raised liver enzymes found on a routine blood test without symptoms. The most common causes are fatty liver, alcohol, medicines and viral hepatitis.
إعادة التحليل وإكمال فحص الأسباب (فيروسا: Repeat the test and complete checks for causes (hepatitis viruses, iron, ultrasound) depending on the pattern, and reduce weight and alcohol. See a doctor to assess the result rather than simply repeating the test without an explanation.
تغيّر في بطانة الجزء السفلي من المريء نت: A change in the lining of the lower oesophagus caused by long-term reflux. It carries a low risk of turning into oesophageal cancer and is diagnosed by endoscopy and biopsy.
علاج الارتجاع بمثبطات الحموضة، ومنظار مر: Reflux treatment with acid-suppressing medicines, regular surveillance endoscopy depending on the length of the change and biopsy results, and endoscopic treatment if dysplasia is found. See a gastroenterologist, and seek review promptly if you have difficulty swallowing or weight loss.
تآكل والتهاب في بطانة المريء بسبب ارتجاع: Erosion and inflammation of the oesophageal lining caused by stomach acid reflux. It causes burning behind the breastbone and pain on swallowing, and can lead to bleeding or narrowing.
مثبطات مضخة البروتون لعدة أسابيع، ورفع ر: Proton pump inhibitors for several weeks, raising the head of the bed, not eating before bed, and losing weight. See a doctor if you have difficulty swallowing, vomit blood, have black stools or do not improve.
اضطراب في حركة المريء يمنع ارتخاء العضلة: A disorder of oesophageal movement in which the lower sphincter muscle does not relax, making it hard to swallow both liquids and solid food, with undigested food coming back up.
تأكيد التشخيص بقياس ضغط المريء والمنظار،: The diagnosis is confirmed with oesophageal pressure testing (manometry) and endoscopy, followed by balloon widening of the sphincter or cutting it endoscopically or surgically. See a gastroenterologist, as the condition progresses over time.
ضيق في المريء ينتج غالبًا عن ارتجاع مزمن: A narrowing of the oesophagus usually caused by long-term reflux, swallowing a corrosive substance or radiotherapy. It causes increasing difficulty swallowing solid food.
منظار لتأكيد طبيعة التضيّق وأخذ خزعة، ثم: Endoscopy to confirm the nature of the narrowing and take a biopsy, then endoscopic widening along with reflux treatment. See a doctor soon, and go to the emergency department if food gets stuck and you cannot swallow saliva.
انزلاق جزء من المعدة إلى الصدر عبر فتحة: Part of the stomach slides up into the chest through the oesophageal opening in the diaphragm. It often causes no symptoms or causes reflux that worsens after eating and when bending.
علاج الارتجاع بتعديل نمط الحياة ومثبطات: Reflux treatment with lifestyle changes and acid-suppressing medicines. Surgery is considered for large hernias or those with complications. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you have severe chest pain with vomiting and cannot swallow.
التهاب مزمن تحسسي في المريء يؤدي إلى صعو: A chronic allergic inflammation of the oesophagus that causes difficulty swallowing and food repeatedly getting stuck. It is common in young people and those with asthma or allergies.
تأكيد التشخيص بخزعات من المريء، ثم مثبطا: The diagnosis is confirmed with oesophageal biopsies, followed by proton pump inhibitors, swallowed topical steroids or removing specific foods, and widening of the oesophagus if narrowed. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if food is stuck and you cannot swallow saliva.
تمزق طولي في بطانة الوصلة بين المريء وال: A lengthwise tear in the lining where the oesophagus meets the stomach, caused by forceful vomiting or retching. It causes vomiting of blood that usually stops on its own.
أي قيء دموي يستلزم تقييمًا في الطوارئ لق: Any vomiting of blood needs assessment in the emergency department to check blood levels and vital signs, an upper endoscopy, anti-sickness and acid-suppressing medicines. Most tears heal within days.
تمزق كامل في جدار المريء بعد قيء عنيف، ي: A full-thickness tear in the oesophageal wall after forceful vomiting. It causes severe pain in the chest or upper abdomen, which may be followed by shortness of breath and fever, and is a serious surgical condition.
حالة طارئة تحتاج إلى أشعة مقطعية عاجلة و: An emergency that needs an urgent CT scan, nothing by mouth, intravenous antibiotics, and surgical or endoscopic treatment. Go to the emergency department immediately.
انحشار الطعام في المريء: Food bolus obstruction in the oesophagus
توقف لقمة طعام (غالبًا لحم) في المريء فل: A mouthful of food (often meat) gets stuck in the oesophagus and will not pass into the stomach, usually because of a narrowing or eosinophilic inflammation. Sometimes it prevents swallowing saliva.
إذا تعذّر بلع اللعاب فالمراجعة الفورية ل: If you cannot swallow saliva, go to the emergency department straight away for endoscopic removal within hours, followed by investigation of the cause. Do not try to push the food down by eating bread or fizzy drinks.
جيب يبرز من الجدار الخلفي لأعلى المريء ع: A pouch bulging from the back wall of the upper oesophagus at the throat. Food collects in it and comes back up undigested, causing bad breath and coughing. It is common in older people.
تصوير بلع الباريوم للتشخيص، والعلاج بقطع: A barium swallow X-ray for diagnosis, and endoscopic or surgical division of the wall if there are symptoms. See a doctor, especially if you have repeated coughing or chest infections after eating.
التهاب مزمن يؤدي إلى ضمور غدد المعدة، إم: Chronic inflammation leading to loss of the stomach glands, either autoimmune (causing vitamin B12 deficiency) or due to long-term H. pylori infection. It slightly increases the risk of stomach tumours.
تعويض فيتامين ب12 والحديد عند نقصهما، وع: Replacement of vitamin B12 and iron if low, treatment of H. pylori if present, and regular surveillance endoscopy depending on extent. See a doctor for diagnosis by endoscopy and biopsies.
بطء تفريغ المعدة دون انسداد، أشيع أسبابه: Slow emptying of the stomach without a blockage. The most common causes are diabetes, some medicines and surgery. It causes nausea, vomiting of old food and early fullness.
وجبات صغيرة متعددة قليلة الدهون والألياف: Small, frequent meals low in fat and fibre, blood sugar control, review of medicines that slow the stomach, and medicines that stimulate stomach movement and anti-sickness medicines. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you have persistent vomiting with dehydration.
ثقب في جدار المعدة أو الاثني عشر بسبب قر: A hole in the wall of the stomach or duodenum caused by an ulcer, letting stomach contents leak into the abdomen. It causes sudden, very severe pain and a rigid abdomen.
حالة جراحية طارئة: صيام وسوائل ومضادات ح: A surgical emergency: nothing by mouth, fluids and intravenous antibiotics, usually surgery to close the hole, followed by H. pylori treatment and avoiding anti-inflammatory painkillers. Go to the emergency department immediately.
أعراض تستدعي استبعاد سرطان المعدة: Symptoms that need stomach cancer to be ruled out
علامات إنذار قد تدل على ورم في المعدة، م: Warning signs that may point to a stomach tumour, such as new persistent indigestion after 55 with weight loss, anaemia, early fullness or repeated vomiting.
يحتاج إلى منظار علوي عاجل مع خزعات خلال: Needs an urgent upper endoscopy with biopsies within about two weeks. See a doctor without delay, and go to the emergency department if you vomit blood or have black stools.
اضطراب وظيفي يتميز بنوبات متكررة من الغث: A functional disorder with repeated episodes of nausea and severe vomiting lasting hours to days, separated by completely normal periods. It is linked to migraine and sometimes to long-term cannabis use.
استبعاد الأسباب العضوية، ثم علاج النوبة: Other causes are ruled out first, then episodes are treated with anti-sickness medicines and fluids, with preventive medicine if episodes recur, and avoiding triggers such as lack of sleep and cannabis. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you are dehydrated or vomit blood.
أعراض تحدث بعد جراحات المعدة (كجراحات ال: Symptoms after stomach surgery (such as weight-loss surgery) caused by food moving too quickly into the bowel. It causes sweating, palpitations, cramps and diarrhoea straight after eating, or low blood sugar a few hours later.
وجبات صغيرة متكررة غنية بالبروتين والألي: Small, frequent meals rich in protein and fibre and low in simple sugars, drinking fluids separately from food, and lying down after eating. See a doctor if symptoms persist or low blood sugar keeps recurring.
زيادة غير طبيعية في بكتيريا الأمعاء الدق: An abnormal increase in bacteria in the small bowel, usually after bowel surgery or with slow gut movement or diabetes. It causes bloating, diarrhoea and poor absorption.
تأكيد التشخيص باختبار التنفس، ثم مضاد حي: The diagnosis is confirmed with a breath test, followed by a short course of a gut antibiotic, treatment of the cause, and vitamin B12 replacement if low. See a doctor and do not use antibiotics without a diagnosis.
إسهال مائي مزمن بسبب وصول أحماض صفراوية: Chronic watery diarrhoea caused by too much bile acid reaching the colon. It occurs after gallbladder removal or surgery on the end of the small bowel, or without a clear cause.
أدوية رابطة للأحماض الصفراوية تحسّن الإس: Bile acid binding medicines usually improve the diarrhoea, along with eating less fat. See a doctor to rule out other causes of chronic diarrhoea.
أعراض هضمية أو عامة تظهر مع أكل القمح وت: Digestive or general symptoms that appear after eating wheat and improve when it is stopped, in people who have been shown not to have coeliac disease or wheat allergy.
يجب إجراء تحاليل السيلياك قبل إيقاف القم: Coeliac tests must be done before stopping wheat, followed by a trial of a low-gluten diet under a dietitian's supervision, with reintroduction to confirm the link. See a doctor before starting any long-term diet.
التهاب في بطانة القولون لا يُرى بالعين ف: Inflammation of the bowel lining that cannot be seen at colonoscopy but is found on biopsy. It causes chronic watery diarrhoea without blood and is more common in women over 50 and with some medicines.
منظار قولون مع خزعات للتشخيص، ومراجعة ال: Colonoscopy with biopsies for diagnosis, review of triggering medicines, and a locally acting steroid, which most people respond to. See a doctor for assessment.
نقص مؤقت في تروية جزء من القولون، يصيب ك: A temporary reduction in blood supply to part of the colon, mostly in older people. It causes sudden abdominal pain (usually on the left) followed by blood with stools.
تقييم عاجل في المستشفى بالأشعة المقطعية: Urgent hospital assessment with a CT scan and colonoscopy. Most cases improve with fluids and bowel rest, though antibiotics or surgery may be needed in severe cases. Go to the emergency department if you have severe pain, heavy bleeding or dizziness.
انقطاع مفاجئ في تروية الأمعاء بسبب جلطة: A sudden loss of blood supply to the bowel caused by a clot or blockage in its arteries. It causes very severe pain out of proportion to examination findings and is life-threatening.
حالة طارئة تحتاج إلى أشعة مقطعية للأوعية: An emergency that needs an immediate CT angiogram, blood thinners, and reopening of the artery or surgery to remove the damaged section. Go to the emergency department immediately.
تضيّق مزمن في شرايين الأمعاء بسبب تصلّب: Long-term narrowing of the bowel arteries due to atherosclerosis. It causes pain after eating, fear of eating and weight loss, and affects smokers and older people.
يحتاج إلى تصوير الأوعية خلال أيام، وتوسي: Needs imaging of the blood vessels within days, and widening of the artery by catheter or surgery, with stopping smoking and treatment of risk factors. Go to the emergency department if the pain suddenly gets worse.
التواء جزء من القولون حول نفسه يسبب انسد: Part of the colon twists on itself, causing a blockage and possibly cutting off blood supply. It is common in older people and those with chronic constipation.
حالة طارئة: أشعة مقطعية، ثم فك الالتواء: An emergency: a CT scan, then endoscopic untwisting, usually for sigmoid volvulus, or surgery if this fails or the bowel is damaged. Go to the emergency department immediately.
انزلاق جزء من الأمعاء داخل الجزء المجاور: Part of the bowel slides into the section next to it. It is rare in adults and usually caused by a tumour or polyp, and causes intermittent cramps and sometimes blood in the stools.
تقييم عاجل بالأشعة المقطعية، والعلاج جرا: Urgent assessment with a CT scan. Treatment in adults is usually surgical, with investigation of the cause. Go to the emergency department, especially if you are vomiting or not passing wind.
التهاب الغشاء المبطن للبطن، غالبًا بسبب: Inflammation of the lining of the abdomen, usually caused by a perforated digestive organ or advanced appendicitis or diverticulitis. It causes widespread pain that worsens with movement, a rigid abdomen and fever.
حالة جراحية طارئة: سوائل ومضادات حيوية و: A surgical emergency: fluids, intravenous antibiotics and surgery or drainage to treat the source. Go to the emergency department immediately.
نتوءات في بطانة القولون، بعضها (الأورام: Growths on the lining of the colon. Some (adenomas) can slowly turn into cancer. Most cause no symptoms but may cause mild bleeding.
منظار قولون لاستئصالها وتحليلها، ثم منظا: Colonoscopy to remove and test them, then follow-up colonoscopy depending on number, size and type, and early screening for relatives of people with bowel cancer. See a doctor to arrange a colonoscopy.
نزيف غزير من القولون أو المستقيم يظهر بد: Heavy bleeding from the colon or rectum showing as red blood or clots from the anus. Causes include diverticula, haemorrhoids, abnormal blood vessels, tumours and inflammation.
تقييم فوري في الطوارئ للعلامات الحيوية و: Immediate assessment in the emergency department of vital signs and haemoglobin, fluid and blood replacement, then colonoscopy or angiography to find and stop the source. Go to the emergency department immediately.
نوع من متلازمة القولون العصبي يغلب فيه ا: A type of irritable bowel syndrome in which diarrhoea is the main feature, with recurrent abdominal pain related to bowel movements and bloating, without a structural disease.
استبعاد السيلياك والالتهابات بتحاليل بسي: Rule out coeliac disease and inflammation with simple tests, then a low-FODMAP diet, anti-diarrhoea and antispasmodic medicines when needed, and stress management. See a doctor if you notice blood, weight loss or diarrhoea at night.
نوع من متلازمة القولون العصبي يغلب فيه ا: A type of irritable bowel syndrome in which constipation is the main feature, with recurrent abdominal pain that improves or changes with bowel movements, and bloating.
زيادة الألياف الذائبة والسوائل والنشاط ا: More soluble fibre, fluids and physical activity, osmotic laxatives and antispasmodics, and specific medicines if there is no response. See a doctor if you notice blood, weight loss or a new change after 50.
نوع من متلازمة القولون العصبي يتناوب فيه: A type of irritable bowel syndrome in which diarrhoea and constipation alternate, with recurrent abdominal pain and bloating.
تنظيم الوجبات وتجربة نظام منخفض الفودماب: Regular meals and a trial of a low-FODMAP diet, antispasmodics, treating the main pattern in each episode, and stress management. See a doctor if warning signs such as blood or weight loss appear.
بروز في السرة أو حولها لجزء من الدهون أو: A bulge at or around the belly button where fat or bowel pushes through a weak spot in the abdominal wall. It gets bigger with coughing, pregnancy and obesity.
تقييم لدى الجراح، والإصلاح الجراحي مفضّل: Assessment by a surgeon. Surgical repair is preferred for painful, medium or large hernias. Go to the emergency department if the hernia becomes painful and hard and will not go back in, or if you are vomiting.
بروز في موضع جرح عملية سابقة في البطن بس: A bulge at the site of a previous abdominal surgery scar caused by poor healing of the wall layers. It is more likely with obesity, smoking and wound infection.
تقييم لدى الجراح، والإصلاح بشبكة عند وجو: Assessment by a surgeon, and mesh repair if there are symptoms or it is large, with weight loss and stopping smoking before surgery. Go to the emergency department if you have severe pain and the hernia will not go back in.
بروز صغير في الخط الأوسط للبطن بين السرة: A small bulge in the midline of the abdomen between the belly button and the lower breastbone, usually containing fat. It may hurt when straining.
الإصلاح الجراحي عند وجود ألم أو كبر، وال: Surgical repair if it is painful or large, and monitoring for small painless hernias. Go to the emergency department if you have severe pain and hardness.
بروز تحت ثنية الفخذ في أعلى الفخذ، أشيع: A bulge below the groin crease at the top of the thigh. It is more common in women and has a higher risk of strangulation than an inguinal hernia.
يحتاج إلى تقييم جراحي قريب وإصلاح مبكر ب: Needs a prompt surgical assessment and early repair because of the risk of strangulation. Go to the emergency department immediately if it becomes painful and hard and will not go back in, or if you are vomiting.
فتق لم يعد يرجع إلى مكانه، وقد يُقطع الد: A hernia that no longer goes back in. Blood supply to the trapped bowel may be cut off, making it painful, hard and red, and it may cause a bowel obstruction.
حالة جراحية طارئة: لا تحاول دفع الفتق بق: A surgical emergency: do not try to force the hernia back in. Go to the emergency department immediately for urgent surgical repair.
انفصال عضلات البطن المستقيمة: Diastasis recti (separation of the abdominal muscles)
اتساع المسافة بين عضلتي البطن المستقيمتي: Widening of the gap between the two rectus abdominal muscles after pregnancy or with obesity, causing a lengthwise bulge down the middle of the abdomen when the muscles are tensed. It is not a hernia and is not dangerous.
تمارين تقوية عضلات البطن العميقة بإشراف: Deep core strengthening exercises guided by a physiotherapist, and avoiding incorrect heavy lifting. Many cases improve within a year after childbirth. See a doctor if a painful local bulge appears or it does not improve.
خروج جدار المستقيم كاملًا عبر فتحة الشرج: The full wall of the rectum comes out through the anus as a round red lump. It is common in older people, women and those with chronic constipation.
علاج الإمساك وتجنّب الإجهاد عند التبرّز،: Treating constipation and avoiding straining when opening the bowels. Definitive treatment is usually surgical. See a surgeon, and go to the emergency department if the prolapse will not go back in, turns dark or becomes very painful.
أعراض تستدعي استبعاد سرطان الشرج: Symptoms that need anal cancer to be ruled out
علامات قد تدل على ورم في فتحة الشرج، مثل: Signs that may point to a tumour at the anus, such as a hard lump or a non-healing sore with bleeding or pain. It is often linked to human papillomavirus (HPV).
يحتاج إلى فحص سريري وخزعة خلال أسبوعين ت: Needs a clinical examination and biopsy within about two weeks, and referral to a cancer team if confirmed. Do not assume every anal lump is a haemorrhoid; see a doctor without delay.
نوبات ألم مفاجئ حاد في الشرج تستمر ثواني: Episodes of sudden sharp pain in the anus lasting seconds to minutes and then going away completely. It is caused by spasm of the pelvic floor muscles and is harmless.
الطمأنة، ومغطس ماء دافئ أو إرخاء عضلات ا: Reassurance, a warm bath or relaxing the pelvic muscles during an episode, and treating constipation and stress. See a doctor if the pain becomes constant or comes with bleeding, a lump or fever.
عدم القدرة على التحكم في خروج البراز أو: Inability to control the passing of stools or wind. It can occur after a difficult childbirth or anal surgery, or with chronic diarrhoea, nerve conditions or older age.
علاج السبب كالإسهال أو الإمساك المزمن، و: Treating the cause, such as chronic diarrhoea or constipation, pelvic floor exercises and biofeedback, medicines that regulate stool consistency, and surgery in selected cases. See a doctor without embarrassment, and seek review promptly if it starts suddenly with leg weakness or numbness around the anus.
تكتّل براز صلب في المستقيم أو القولون لا: A mass of hard stool in the rectum or colon that cannot be passed. It is common in older and bedbound people and those taking constipating medicines, and liquid stool may leak around it and be mistaken for diarrhoea.
يحتاج إلى فحص طبي خلال يوم أو يومين لإزا: Needs a medical examination within a day or two to remove it with enemas, suppositories or manually, then a plan to prevent recurrence with laxatives, fluids and a medicine review. Go to the emergency department if you have severe pain, bloating and vomiting.
عدوى فيروسية سريعة الانتشار تسبب قيئًا و: A fast-spreading viral infection that causes sudden vomiting and watery diarrhoea lasting one to three days. It spreads in outbreaks within families, schools and ships.
الإكثار من السوائل ومحلول معالجة الجفاف،: Plenty of fluids and oral rehydration solution, rest, handwashing with soap and water (alcohol gel is not enough), and staying at home until two days after symptoms stop. See a doctor if you have signs of dehydration, blood in the stools or vomiting for more than two days.
عدوى بكتيرية شائعة تنتقل غالبًا من الدجا: A common bacterial infection usually caught from undercooked chicken. It causes severe cramps and diarrhoea, which may be bloody, with fever.
السوائل ومحلول معالجة الجفاف، وتُشفى غال: Fluids and oral rehydration solution. It usually clears within a week, and antibiotics are given in severe cases or to people with weakened immunity. See a doctor if you have blood in the stools, high fever or dehydration.
عدوى بكتيرية تنتقل غالبًا عبر البيض والد: A bacterial infection usually caught from undercooked eggs and chicken. It causes diarrhoea, fever and cramps within one to three days of eating.
السوائل ومحلول معالجة الجفاف، ولا تحتاج: Fluids and oral rehydration solution. Antibiotics are usually not needed except for infants, older people, people with weakened immunity and severe cases. See a doctor if you have persistent fever, dehydration or blood in the stools.
عدوى بكتيرية شديدة العدوى في القولون تنت: A highly contagious bacterial infection of the colon spread by hands and contaminated food. It causes bloody, mucousy diarrhoea with fever and tenesmus (a repeated feeling of needing to open the bowels).
السوائل، ومضاد حيوي بحسب زراعة البراز ون: Fluids, antibiotics guided by stool culture and local resistance patterns, and careful handwashing to prevent spread. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you are dehydrated or passing little urine.
عدوى بسلالات من الإشريكية القولونية تنتق: Infection with strains of E. coli spread through undercooked minced meat, vegetables or unpasteurised milk. It causes bloody diarrhoea and severe cramps and can lead to haemolytic uraemic syndrome and kidney failure, especially in children.
يحتاج إلى تقييم طبي عاجل وزراعة براز وتح: Needs urgent medical assessment with stool culture, blood and kidney function tests, and fluids. Antibiotics and anti-diarrhoea medicines are usually not used, as they may increase the risk. Go to the emergency department immediately if you are passing little urine, look pale or are drowsy.
التهاب في القولون تسببه بكتيريا المطثية: Inflammation of the colon caused by C. difficile bacteria after gut bacteria are disrupted by antibiotics or a hospital stay. It causes repeated watery diarrhoea and can become severe.
تحليل البراز للسموم خلال يوم أو يومين، و: A stool test for toxins within a day or two, stopping the causative antibiotic if possible, a specific oral antibiotic, fluids, and avoiding anti-diarrhoea medicines. Go to the emergency department if you have severe pain and bloating, high fever or dehydration.
عدوى طفيلية في الأمعاء الدقيقة تنتقل عبر: A parasitic infection of the small bowel spread through untreated water or contaminated food. It causes intermittent diarrhoea, bloating, foul-smelling wind and egg-smelling burps, and may cause poor absorption.
تحليل البراز للتأكيد، ثم علاج مضاد للطفي: A stool test to confirm it, then prescription antiparasitic treatment and fluids. Lactose intolerance may last a few weeks after recovery. See a doctor, and drink boiled or treated water.
عدوى طفيلية بالأميبا الحالّة للنسج تنتقل: A parasitic infection with Entamoeba histolytica spread through contaminated food and water. It causes gradually developing bloody, mucousy diarrhoea and can spread to the liver, forming an abscess.
تحليل البراز أو المستضدات للتأكيد، ثم عل: A stool or antigen test to confirm it, then anti-amoebic treatment followed by a medicine that clears cysts from the bowel. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you have high fever with pain in the upper right abdomen.
عدوى بديدان أسطوانية كبيرة تنتقل بابتلاع: Infection with large roundworms caught by swallowing their eggs from contaminated soil or vegetables. Most cases cause no symptoms, but it may cause abdominal pain or passing a worm in stools or vomit, and rarely a bowel blockage.
دواء مضاد للديدان بجرعة واحدة غالبًا بوص: Usually a single dose of a prescription anti-worm medicine, washing vegetables and hands well, and treating family members as needed. Go to the emergency department if you have severe abdominal pain with vomiting and cannot open your bowels.

إفراز حليبي من الحلمة دون حمل أو رضاعة: Milky discharge from the nipple without pregnancy or breastfeeding
ضعف في مجال الرؤية الجانبي مع صداع مستمر: Loss of side (peripheral) vision with a persistent headache
تضخّم تدريجي في اليدين والقدمين (ضيق الخ: Gradual enlargement of the hands and feet (rings and shoes becoming tight) and changes in facial features
إرهاق وشحوب وبرودة وتساقط شعر الإبط والع: Tiredness, paleness, feeling cold and loss of armpit and pubic hair after heavy bleeding in childbirth, a head injury or pituitary surgery
نقص الصوديوم في التحليل مع بول مركّز دون: Low sodium on a blood test with concentrated urine, without dehydration or swelling
رعشة وتعرّق وجوع بعد ساعتين إلى أربع ساع: Shakiness, sweating and hunger two to four hours after a sugary meal in a person without diabetes

ألم عظام منتشر مع ضعف عضلات الفخذين وصعو: Widespread bone pain with weak thigh muscles and difficulty standing up from sitting or climbing stairs

التهاب مؤلم في الغدة الدرقية يتبع غالبًا: Painful inflammation of the thyroid gland, usually after a viral infection. It causes pain at the front of the neck, fever and a temporary overactive phase that may be followed by a short underactive phase.
يُعالج بمضادات الالتهاب لتخفيف الألم، وق: Treated with anti-inflammatory painkillers, steroids in severe cases, and medicines to ease palpitations if needed. Medicines that block thyroid hormone production do not help. Most people recover within months with follow-up blood tests. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis.
مرض مناعي يهاجم فيه الجسم الغدة الدرقية: An autoimmune condition in which the body gradually attacks the thyroid gland. It is the most common cause of an underactive thyroid and is found by raised antibodies with an enlarged gland or abnormal thyroid hormones.
إذا كانت الهرمونات طبيعية تكفي المتابعة: If hormone levels are normal, regular TSH checks are enough. If the thyroid becomes underactive, thyroid hormone replacement is given, usually lifelong, with the dose adjusted by blood tests. See a doctor for follow-up, and tell them if you are planning a pregnancy.
التهاب مناعي غير مؤلم في الغدة الدرقية خ: Painless autoimmune inflammation of the thyroid in the first year after giving birth. It causes a brief overactive phase, usually followed by an underactive phase, and most cases return to normal.
تحليل وظائف الدرقية؛ وقد تلزم أدوية لتخف: Thyroid function tests. Medicines to ease palpitations may be needed in the overactive phase, and thyroid hormone replacement in the underactive phase, with yearly checks for permanent underactivity. See a doctor, especially if you have symptoms of postnatal depression.
ارتفاع خفيف في هرمون TSH مع بقاء هرمون ا: A slightly raised TSH while thyroid hormone T4 remains normal, usually without clear symptoms. It may progress to an overt underactive thyroid, especially if antibodies are present.
يُعاد التحليل بعد ثلاثة أشهر للتأكد؛ وكث: The test is repeated after three months to confirm it. Many cases need monitoring rather than treatment; treatment is considered if TSH rises further, during or when planning pregnancy, or if there are symptoms. See a doctor to decide whether treatment is needed.
انخفاض هرمون TSH مع بقاء هرمونات الدرقية: A low TSH while thyroid hormones remain in the normal range. It may be caused by active thyroid nodules, early Graves' disease or too high a dose of thyroid hormone replacement.
يُعاد التحليل للتأكد ويُحدد السبب؛ ويُنظ: The test is repeated to confirm it and the cause is identified. Treatment is considered especially in older people or those with heart disease or osteoporosis, to reduce the risk of atrial fibrillation and bone weakness. See a doctor, and do not change your thyroid hormone dose yourself.
عقدة أو عدة عقد في الغدة الدرقية تفرز ال: One or more nodules in the thyroid gland that produce hormone independently of the body's control, causing an overactive thyroid. It is common in older people and in iodine-deficient areas.
يُشخَّص بالتحاليل ومسح الغدة بالنظائر ال: It is diagnosed with blood tests and a radioactive isotope scan of the thyroid, and treated with radioactive iodine or surgery, with medicines to control hormones and palpitations beforehand. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you have a very fast, irregular heartbeat or shortness of breath.
عقدة درقية تستدعي استبعاد الورم: Thyroid nodule that needs cancer to be ruled out
عقدة في الغدة الدرقية تكبر بسرعة أو صلبة: A thyroid nodule that is growing quickly, is hard and fixed, or comes with persistent hoarseness or swollen lymph nodes in the neck needs thyroid cancer to be ruled out, although most thyroid nodules are benign.
إحالة سريعة لإجراء موجات فوق صوتية على ا: Prompt referral for a neck ultrasound and thyroid function tests, with a fine-needle biopsy if needed. Most types of thyroid cancer are curable with treatment. Go to the emergency department if you have difficulty breathing or swallowing.
التهاب مناعي في أنسجة محجر العين يصاحب غ: Autoimmune inflammation of the tissues around the eye, usually with Graves' disease. It causes bulging and red eyes, swollen eyelids and a gritty feeling, and may cause double vision.
ضبط هرمونات الدرقية، والإقلاع عن التدخين: Control of thyroid hormones, stopping smoking (the most important factor), lubricating eye drops and sunglasses, selenium supplements in mild cases, and immune-suppressing medicines or newer treatments in moderate to severe active cases. See an eye specialist and an endocrinologist, and go to the emergency department if your vision gets worse or colour vision changes.
تفاقم شديد ومهدد للحياة لفرط نشاط الدرقي: A severe, life-threatening worsening of an overactive thyroid, usually triggered by infection, surgery or stopping treatment. It causes high fever, a very fast heartbeat and confusion, and may lead to heart failure.
حالة طارئة تُعالج في العناية المركزة بأد: An emergency treated in intensive care with medicines that block hormone release and slow the heart, steroids, cooling and treatment of the trigger. Go to the emergency department immediately.
نقص حاد شديد في هرمون الكورتيزول لدى مري: A severe, sudden lack of the hormone cortisol in a person with adrenal insufficiency or on long-term steroids. It usually happens with infection, vomiting or suddenly stopping medicine, and causes low blood pressure and shock.
حالة طارئة تحتاج إلى حقن الهيدروكورتيزون: An emergency that needs an immediate hydrocortisone injection with intravenous fluids. Patients should carry a steroid emergency card and an emergency injection kit, and double their steroid dose during illness as instructed by their doctor. Go to the emergency department immediately.
تثبّط الغدة الكظرية عن إفراز الكورتيزول: Suppression of the adrenal glands' cortisol production after high-dose or long-term steroid use, causing tiredness, dizziness and nausea when steroids are stopped suddenly or during illness.
لا يُوقف الكورتيزون المستعمل لأسابيع فجأ: Steroids taken for weeks should not be stopped suddenly but reduced gradually under medical supervision. An adrenal function test may be needed, along with instructions to double the dose during illness or surgery. See a doctor before making any change, and go to the emergency department if you have persistent vomiting or low blood pressure.
إفراز زائد لهرمون الألدوستيرون من الغدة: Too much aldosterone hormone produced by the adrenal gland (a benign tumour or enlargement of both glands), causing salt retention, high blood pressure and sometimes low potassium. It is one of the most common treatable causes of secondary high blood pressure.
يُشخَّص بتحليل نسبة الألدوستيرون إلى الر: It is diagnosed with an aldosterone-to-renin ratio blood test, followed by confirmatory tests and imaging. It is treated by surgical removal of the gland if only one side is affected, or with aldosterone-blocking medicines. See a doctor if your blood pressure is hard to control or comes with low potassium.
ورم نادر غالبًا حميد في الغدة الكظرية يف: A rare, usually benign tumour of the adrenal gland that releases adrenaline and similar hormones, causing episodes of headache, sweating and palpitations with very high blood pressure.
يُشخَّص بتحليل الميتانفرينات في الدم أو: It is diagnosed by measuring metanephrines in blood or urine, followed by imaging, and treated with surgery after preparation with special medicines to control blood pressure. See a doctor soon, and go to the emergency department if you have a severe episode with chest pain, an extremely severe headache or sudden weakness.
كتلة في الغدة الكظرية تُكتشف مصادفةً في: A lump in the adrenal gland found by chance on a scan done for another reason. Most are benign, non-functioning tumours, but some produce hormones or are cancerous.
يحتاج إلى تقييم لدى طبيب الغدد: تحاليل ل: Needs assessment by an endocrinologist: tests to rule out excess cortisol, aldosterone and adrenaline, and review of the lump's features on imaging. Removal may be needed if it is active, suspicious or large. See a doctor to complete the tests.
ورم حميد في الغدة النخامية يفرز هرمون ال: A benign tumour of the pituitary gland that produces the milk hormone (prolactin). In women it causes irregular periods and milk discharge, and in men low sex drive and erection problems. A large tumour may press on the optic nerves.
يُشخَّص بتحليل البرولاكتين ورنين مغناطيس: It is diagnosed with a prolactin blood test and an MRI scan of the pituitary gland after ruling out pregnancy, medicines and an underactive thyroid. It is usually treated with effective medicines that shrink the tumour, and rarely with surgery. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you have a sudden severe headache with loss of vision.
إفراز زائد لهرمون النمو بعد البلوغ، غالب: Too much growth hormone after puberty, usually from a benign pituitary tumour. It causes gradual enlargement of the hands, feet and facial features, with joint pain, sweating, diabetes and high blood pressure.
يُشخَّص بتحليل عامل النمو IGF-1 واختبار: It is diagnosed with an IGF-1 blood test, a glucose tolerance test and an MRI scan, and is usually treated with surgery through the nose, followed by medicines or radiotherapy if needed. See an endocrinologist.
نقص في هرمون أو أكثر من هرمونات الغدة ال: A lack of one or more pituitary hormones due to a tumour, surgery, radiotherapy, head injury or heavy bleeding during childbirth, weakening the glands it controls (thyroid, adrenal and reproductive glands).
تحاليل هرمونية شاملة ورنين على الغدة الن: Full hormone tests and an MRI scan of the pituitary gland, then lifelong replacement of missing hormones, with steroid replacement given priority before thyroid hormone. See an endocrinologist, and go to the emergency department if you have persistent vomiting or low blood pressure.
متلازمة الإفراز غير الملائم للهرمون المض: Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH)
إفراز زائد للهرمون المضاد لإدرار البول ي: Too much antidiuretic hormone, causing the body to retain water and lowering sodium. Causes include some medicines (such as antidepressants and anti-epileptics), lung and brain conditions, and some tumours.
يُشخَّص بتحاليل الصوديوم وتركيز الدم وال: It is diagnosed with sodium and blood and urine concentration tests, after ruling out underactive thyroid and adrenal glands. It is treated by limiting fluid intake, reviewing medicines, treating the cause and specific medicines if needed, with slow correction of sodium. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you become confused or have a seizure.
أعراض هبوط السكر تظهر بعد ساعتين إلى أرب: Symptoms of low blood sugar two to four hours after eating in people without diabetes, especially after weight-loss or stomach surgery. Many of these symptoms do not come with a true low blood sugar when measured.
قياس السكر أثناء الأعراض لتأكيد الهبوط،: Measure blood sugar during symptoms to confirm a low, then eat small, frequent meals rich in fibre and protein and low in simple sugars. See a doctor if a low is confirmed by measurement or you lose consciousness.
هبوط السكر الصيامي لدى غير مرضى السكري (: Fasting hypoglycaemia in people without diabetes (to rule out insulinoma)
هبوط سكر مؤكد أثناء الصيام لدى شخص لا يت: Confirmed low blood sugar during fasting in a person not taking diabetes medicines. Causes include an insulin-producing pancreatic tumour, liver or adrenal failure, and some medicines.
يحتاج إلى تقييم سريع لدى طبيب الغدد بقيا: Needs prompt assessment by an endocrinologist, measuring blood sugar and insulin during a low episode (often with a supervised fasting test), followed by imaging. An insulinoma is treated with surgery. Always carry a fast-acting sugar, and go to the emergency department if you become confused or lose consciousness.
اجتماع السمنة البطنية مع اثنين أو أكثر م: Abdominal obesity combined with two or more of: high blood pressure, high fasting blood sugar, high triglycerides or low HDL (good) cholesterol. It greatly increases the risk of diabetes and heart disease.
إنقاص الوزن بنسبة 5–10% بنظام غذائي صحي: Losing 5–10% of body weight with a healthy diet and at least 150 minutes of physical activity a week is the basis, with medicines for each component when needed. See a doctor to check blood sugar, cholesterol and blood pressure.
مؤشر كتلة جسم بين 25 و29.9، وهي مرحلة تس: A body mass index (BMI) between 25 and 29.9. It is a stage before obesity and increases the risk of diabetes and high blood pressure, especially with a larger waist size.
نظام غذائي متوازن يقلل السعرات والسكريات: A balanced diet with fewer calories, sugars and sweetened drinks, regular physical activity, enough sleep, and self-monitoring of weight. See a doctor to check blood sugar, blood pressure and cholesterol, especially if you have a family history of diabetes.
مؤشر كتلة جسم 40 فأكثر، أو 35 فأكثر مع أ: A body mass index (BMI) of 40 or more, or 35 or more with weight-related conditions. It is linked to a much higher risk of diabetes, heart disease, sleep apnoea and osteoarthritis.
برنامج متكامل لإدارة الوزن يشمل التغذية: A comprehensive weight-management programme including nutrition, activity and behavioural support, newer weight-loss medicines for suitable patients, and weight-loss surgery as an effective option for those who meet the criteria. See a doctor to make a comprehensive plan and check for complications.
ضعف تمعدن العظام لدى البالغين، غالبًا بس: Poor mineralisation of the bones in adults, usually due to severe, long-term vitamin D or calcium deficiency. It causes widespread bone pain and weak thigh muscles and may cause fractures.
يُشخَّص بتحاليل فيتامين د والكالسيوم وال: It is diagnosed with vitamin D, calcium, phosphate and alkaline phosphatase tests, and treated with treatment doses of vitamin D with calcium as prescribed by your doctor, along with treating the cause, such as poor absorption. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis.
نقص هرمون الغدة جار الدرقية، وأشيع أسباب: A lack of parathyroid hormone, most commonly after neck surgery. Blood calcium falls, causing tingling around the mouth and fingers and muscle cramps.
تحليل الكالسيوم والفوسفات والهرمون، ثم م: Calcium, phosphate and hormone tests, then calcium and active vitamin D supplements under medical supervision, with monitoring of calcium in blood and urine. Go to the emergency department if you have severe cramps, seizures or difficulty breathing.
تقرّحات الفم والتهاب اللسان مع أنيميا لد: Mouth ulcers and a sore tongue with anaemia in a person with poor nutrition, heavy alcohol use or taking medicines that affect folic acid
اصفرار العينين مع شحوب وبول داكن دون مرض: Yellowing of the eyes with paleness and dark urine without known liver disease
تضخّم الطحال أو ثقل وامتلاء في أعلى يسار: An enlarged spleen or heaviness and fullness in the upper left abdomen
تحليل دم يُظهر كريات حمراء صغيرة الحجم (: Blood test showing small red blood cells (low MCV) with normal iron stores
ألم صدر أو ضيق نفس أو حمّى، أو ألم شديد: Chest pain, shortness of breath or fever, or severe pain not relieved by home painkillers, in a person with sickle cell disease
فحص ما قبل الزواج أو فحص دم يُظهر حمل صف: Premarital screening or a blood test showing sickle cell trait
انخفاض في كل خلايا الدم (الحمراء والبيضا: Low levels of all blood cells (red cells, white cells and platelets) on a blood test
حكة شديدة بعد الاستحمام بالماء الدافئ مع: Severe itching after a warm bath or shower with facial flushing
هيموغلوبين أو هيماتوكريت مرتفع في التحلي: High haemoglobin or haematocrit on a blood test
صفائح دموية مرتفعة باستمرار في التحليل: Persistently high platelets on a blood test
نزيف غزير بعد خلع الأسنان أو الجراحة أو: Heavy bleeding after tooth extraction or surgery, or heavy periods since puberty, with a family history of bleeding
آلام عظام مستمرة (خاصة في الظهر) لدى شخص: Persistent bone pain (especially in the back) in a person over 50 with anaemia or minor fractures
بروتين أحادي النسيلة (شريط M) في تحليل ب: Monoclonal protein (M-band) on a blood protein test
عدد العدلات (نوع من كريات الدم البيضاء): Low neutrophil count (a type of white blood cell) on a blood test
حمّى 38 درجة فأكثر أثناء العلاج الكيميائ: Fever of 38 degrees or higher during chemotherapy or with a known low white blood cell count
أنيميا خفيفة مستمرة لدى مريض بمرض مزمن (: Persistent mild anaemia in a person with a chronic condition (arthritis, kidney disease or chronic infection)
ألم مفاصل وإرهاق مع ارتفاع مخزون الحديد: Joint pain and tiredness with high iron stores (ferritin) and transferrin saturation
نقاط نزفية مع تشوّش أو ضعف مفاجئ أو اصفر: Pinpoint bleeding spots with confusion or sudden weakness, or rapid yellowing and paleness
أنيميا مزمنة لا تستجيب للحديد أو الفيتام: Chronic anaemia that does not respond to iron or vitamins in an older person
نزيف أنف متكرر منذ الصغر مع بقع حمراء صغ: Frequent nosebleeds since childhood with small red spots on the lips, tongue and fingers
حصوات مرارة في سن صغيرة مع أنيميا أو اصف: Gallstones at a young age with anaemia or recurrent yellowing and a similar family history
أنيميا بكريات حمراء كبيرة الحجم بسبب نقص: Anaemia with large red blood cells caused by a lack of folic acid due to eating few leafy vegetables, heavy alcohol use, pregnancy, poor absorption or some medicines.
تحليل الفولات وفيتامين ب12 معًا قبل العل: Test folate and vitamin B12 together before treatment (because treating folate alone can hide B12 deficiency), then folic acid supplements with more leafy vegetables and pulses, and treatment of the cause. Folic acid supplements are recommended before and in early pregnancy. See a doctor.
تكسّر كريات الدم الحمراء بسبب أجسام مضاد: Destruction of red blood cells by antibodies made by the immune system against them, causing anaemia with yellowing and dark urine. It may be linked to autoimmune or lymphatic conditions or medicines.
يحتاج إلى تقييم سريع بتحاليل الدم واختبا: Needs prompt assessment with blood tests and a direct Coombs test. Treatment usually includes steroids, other immune-suppressing medicines when needed, and blood transfusion in severe cases. See a doctor the same day, and go to the emergency department if you have shortness of breath, chest pain or severe dizziness.
مرض وراثي يجعل كريات الدم الحمراء كروية: An inherited condition that makes red blood cells round and fragile, so many are destroyed in the spleen. It causes anaemia, recurrent yellowing, an enlarged spleen and gallstones at an early age.
تختلف شدته؛ وتشمل الرعاية مكملات حمض الف: Severity varies. Care includes folic acid supplements, blood transfusion when needed, removal of the spleen in moderate and severe cases with the necessary vaccinations beforehand, and gallbladder removal if there are painful stones. See a haematologist, and go to the emergency department if you become suddenly very pale after an infection.
حالة وراثية يحمل فيها الشخص جينًا واحدًا: An inherited condition in which a person carries one faulty thalassaemia gene, so their red blood cells are small, with very mild or no anaemia. It usually needs no treatment but is important when planning marriage.
لا تحتاج إلى علاج، ولا يجوز تناول الحديد: No treatment is needed, and iron should not be taken unless a deficiency is confirmed by a blood test. Most important is testing your partner before marriage and genetic counselling, because two carriers may have a child with thalassaemia major. See a doctor to confirm the diagnosis with haemoglobin electrophoresis.
مضاعفات الأنيميا المنجلية الحادة (المتلا: Acute sickle cell complications (acute chest syndrome and severe crisis)
مضاعفات حادة لدى مرضى الأنيميا المنجلية،: Acute complications in people with sickle cell disease. The most serious are acute chest syndrome (chest pain, fever and shortness of breath), severe pain crises not relieved by painkillers, and fever that may mean a serious infection.
حالة طارئة تحتاج إلى مسكنات قوية سريعة و: An emergency that needs rapid strong pain relief, fluids, oxygen and antibiotics, and a blood transfusion may be needed. Patients should carry a care plan from their doctor. Go to the emergency department immediately.
حمل جين واحد للخلايا المنجلية دون الإصاب: Carrying one sickle cell gene without having the disease. It usually causes no symptoms, but two carriers may have a child with sickle cell disease.
لا يحتاج إلى علاج. يُنصح بفحص الشريك قبل: No treatment is needed. Testing your partner before marriage and genetic counselling are recommended, along with drinking enough water and avoiding extreme exertion in heat and at high altitude. See a doctor if you notice blood in the urine or severe pain with exertion.
فشل نخاع العظم في إنتاج خلايا الدم بأنوا: Failure of the bone marrow to produce all types of blood cells, so red cells, white cells and platelets all fall, causing anaemia, recurrent infections and bleeding. It is usually immune-related.
يحتاج إلى إحالة عاجلة لطبيب الدم وفحص نخ: Needs urgent referral to a haematologist and a bone marrow test. Treatment includes blood and platelet transfusions, immune-suppressing medicines, or a bone marrow transplant for suitable patients. Go to the emergency department if you have a fever or bleeding that will not stop.
ورم مزمن في نخاع العظم يُنتج كريات حمراء: A chronic bone marrow cancer that produces too many red blood cells (and often platelets and white cells), thickening the blood and increasing the risk of clots. It causes itching after bathing, facial flushing and headaches.
يُشخَّص بتحليل الدم وفحص طفرة JAK2؛ ويشم: It is diagnosed with blood tests and a JAK2 mutation test. Treatment includes regular removal of blood (venesection), low-dose aspirin as prescribed by your doctor, and medicines that reduce blood cell production for those at higher risk of clots. See a haematologist, and go to the emergency department if you have symptoms of a clot.
ورم مزمن في نخاع العظم يُنتج صفائح دموية: A chronic bone marrow cancer that produces too many platelets, increasing the risk of clots and sometimes bleeding. It is usually found by chance on a blood test.
يجب أولًا استبعاد الأسباب الثانوية الشائ: Common secondary causes of high platelets (iron deficiency, inflammation and infection) must be ruled out first, followed by tests for related mutations. Treatment includes aspirin as prescribed by your doctor and platelet-lowering medicines depending on risk. See a haematologist.
أشيع اضطرابات النزف الوراثية، ينتج عن نق: The most common inherited bleeding disorder, caused by a lack or defect of a protein that helps platelets stick. It causes frequent gum bleeding and nosebleeds, bruising, heavy periods and prolonged bleeding after surgery.
يُشخَّص بتحاليل التجلط الخاصة؛ ويشمل الع: It is diagnosed with special clotting tests. Treatment includes medicines that increase release of the protein, clot-stabilising (antifibrinolytic) medicines or factor replacement before surgery, and treatment of heavy periods. Avoid aspirin and anti-inflammatories, and tell your dentist or surgeon. Go to the emergency department if bleeding will not stop.
أعراض تستدعي استبعاد الورم النقوي المتعد: Symptoms that need multiple myeloma to be ruled out
سرطان في خلايا البلازما بنخاع العظم يصيب: A cancer of plasma cells in the bone marrow that mostly affects people over 50. It shows as persistent bone pain, especially in the back, anaemia, minor fractures, high calcium, declining kidney function and recurrent infections.
إحالة سريعة: صورة دم كاملة وتحليل بروتين: Prompt referral: full blood count, blood and urine protein tests, free light chains, calcium and kidney function, then a bone marrow test and imaging. Effective modern treatments are available. Go to the emergency department if you have sudden leg weakness or loss of bladder or bowel control.
وجود بروتين أحادي النسيلة بكمية قليلة في: A small amount of monoclonal protein in the blood without symptoms or organ damage. It is common with age, and a small proportion each year progresses to myeloma or similar conditions.
لا يحتاج إلى علاج، بل متابعة دورية بتحال: No treatment is needed, only regular blood test monitoring at intervals set by your doctor according to risk. See a doctor if you develop bone pain, anaemia, declining kidney function or numbness in your hands or feet.
انخفاض عدد العدلات (خلايا مقاومة البكتير: A low number of neutrophils (cells that fight bacteria) in the blood. Causes include a recent viral infection, medicines, autoimmune conditions, vitamin deficiencies or bone marrow disease. A mildly low count can be normal in some people of African and Arab descent.
يعيد الطبيب التحليل ويراجع الأدوية ويبحث: Your doctor will repeat the test, review your medicines and look for the cause, and refer you to a haematologist if the count is very low, persistent or accompanied by low levels of other cells. Go to the emergency department immediately if you develop a fever with neutropenia.
حمّى لدى مريض لديه نقص شديد في العدلات (: Fever in a person with a very low neutrophil count (usually after chemotherapy). It can quickly progress to serious sepsis.
حالة طارئة: مضادات حيوية وريدية واسعة ال: An emergency: broad-spectrum intravenous antibiotics within an hour of arrival after blood cultures are taken. Do not wait, and do not take fever-reducing medicine to mask the fever before assessment. Go to the emergency department immediately.
زيادة حجم الطحال عن الطبيعي، وهو علامة ع: A larger than normal spleen. It is a sign of another condition, such as infection (for example malaria or brucellosis), liver disease and portal hypertension, haemolytic blood disorders or blood cancers.
يحدد الطبيب السبب بصورة دم كاملة ووظائف: Your doctor will find the cause with a full blood count, liver function tests and an abdominal ultrasound, and may refer you to a haematologist. Avoid contact and vigorous sports until assessed, because of the risk of the spleen rupturing. Go to the emergency department if you have sudden severe pain in the upper left abdomen or dizziness.
مرض وراثي يمتص فيه الجسم كمية زائدة من ا: An inherited condition in which the body absorbs too much iron, which is deposited in the liver, joints, pancreas and heart. If untreated, it causes tiredness, joint pain, cirrhosis and diabetes.
يُشخَّص بتحليل الفيريتين ونسبة تشبّع الت: It is diagnosed with ferritin, transferrin saturation and HFE gene tests, and treated with regular removal of blood (venesection) until iron falls and then for maintenance, while avoiding iron supplements, vitamin C supplements and alcohol. Testing first-degree relatives is recommended. See a doctor.
أنيميا الأمراض المزمنة (أنيميا الالتهاب): Anaemia of chronic disease (anaemia of inflammation)
أنيميا خفيفة إلى متوسطة تصاحب الأمراض ال: Mild to moderate anaemia that comes with chronic inflammatory conditions, chronic kidney disease, chronic infection or cancer, because iron is locked away inside the body and blood production is reduced.
يُشخَّص بتحاليل الحديد والفيريتين مع تقي: It is diagnosed with iron and ferritin tests along with assessment of the underlying condition. The most important treatment is controlling the underlying disease. Intravenous iron or medicines that stimulate blood production may be needed in people with kidney disease. Do not take iron without a blood test. See a doctor.
مرض نادر وخطير تتكوّن فيه جلطات دقيقة في: A rare, serious condition in which tiny clots form in small blood vessels, using up platelets and breaking red blood cells. It causes skin bleeding, yellowing, and neurological symptoms such as confusion and weakness.
حالة طارئة تحتاج إلى استبدال البلازما في: An emergency that needs plasma exchange in hospital as soon as possible, with immune-suppressing medicines and newer treatments. Go to the emergency department immediately.
مجموعة من أمراض نخاع العظم تصيب كبار الس: A group of bone marrow conditions, mostly in older people, in which the marrow produces too few, faulty blood cells. It causes chronic anaemia and sometimes low white cells or platelets, and may turn into leukaemia.
يُشخَّص بفحص صورة الدم ونخاع العظم بعد ا: It is diagnosed with a blood film and bone marrow test after ruling out vitamin and iron deficiency. Treatment includes blood transfusions, medicines that stimulate blood production, targeted treatments depending on risk, and a bone marrow transplant for suitable patients. See a haematologist.
مرض وراثي تتكوّن فيه أوعية دموية هشة متو: An inherited condition in which fragile, widened blood vessels form in the nose, skin and internal organs. It causes frequent nosebleeds, small red spots on the lips and fingers, and anaemia, and may affect the lungs, brain and liver.
علاج نزيف الأنف بالمرطبات وعلاجات موضعية: Nosebleeds are treated with moisturisers, topical treatments or cautery, along with iron replacement and screening for and treating abnormal blood vessels in the lungs and brain. Family members are advised to be tested. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if bleeding will not stop or you have a sudden severe headache.
